title: amoria retusa
intro: Amoria retusa, commonly known as the Amoria tree or the Golden Raintree, is a deciduous tree native to tropical Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including the potential to alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues, making it a popular remedy in traditional medicine. The health benefits of Amoria retusa include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing fever and soothing respiratory irritations. The bioactive constituents of Amoria retusa include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
